summary: Buffered file read: reads up to a3 bytes from the buffered file stream a1 into the caller buffer a2, refilling the internal 0x4000-byte buffer from the OS handle via ThreadSafeReadWrapper_803f when exhausted, draining buffered bytes first, then direct-reading any remainder. Tracks bytes read at a1+8 and a1+20, sets the EOF flag at a1+60 when nothing was read, and returns the number of bytes read. Early returns -2 for a non-read stream (mode byte a1+92 != 114 'r'), -1 on error states, 0 at EOF.

operations.description: Reject invalid streams: a1 null or the mode byte at a1+92 not equal to 114 ('r') returns -2.
State gate on a1+56: -3 or -1 returns -1 (error), 1 returns 0 (EOF).
Initialize the transfer: dest cursor a1+12 = a2 and remaining count a1+16 = a3.
Main read loop that runs while bytes remain; exits when the stream flag at a1+88 is set, on EOF, or when a1+16 reaches 0.
Break the loop when the stream control flag at a1+88 is non-zero.
Refill the buffer: clear the TLS error slot via TLSOffsetGetter, then ThreadSafeReadWrapper_803f(a1+68, 1, 0x4000, a1+64) into a1+4.
EOF handling: when the refill returns 0, set a1+60 = 1, and if the backend descriptor at a1+64 has text-mode EOF bit 0x20 in byte 12, set state a1+56 = -1.
Reset the buffer cursor: a1+0 = a1+68 (the OS handle) after a successful refill.
Advance the parse/read state with sub_5357E0(a1, 0); store its result into state a1+56.
When sub_5357E0 returns 1 (end of data), compute bytes consumed so far as sub_536E90(a1+12 - v4) and store it at a1+76.
Verify integrity: when F_4BitFieldPack(a1) does not equal the stored count a1+76, set state a1+56 = -3 and finish.
Finalize the stream record with sub_534D50(a1); bail if it leaves state a1+56 non-zero.
Position bookkeeping: preserve a1+8 and a1+20 around ArithmeticComparison_5620(a1), then restore them and recompute a1+76 as sub_536E90(0).
Drain buffered bytes: copy min(a1+4, a1+16) bytes from the buffer at a1+0 into the dest at a1+12; advance cursor a1+0, dest a1+12, remaining a1+16 and reduce a1+4.
Direct-read the remainder: a1+16 is decremented by ThreadSafeReadWrapper_803f(dest, 1, a1+16, a1+64).
Account the transfer: v22 = a3 - a1+16 bytes read, add v22 to position fields a1+8 and a1+20, and set EOF flag a1+60 = 1 when v22 is 0.
Return v22 (bytes actually read) on the normal path; the no-remaining path returns a3 - a1+16.

clean_pseudocode: int ReadBufferedFileBytes(BufferedFile* f, char* dst, int n) {
f->dst = dst; f->remaining = n;   // a1+12, a1+16
int p = f->pos, q = f->acc; ArithmeticComparison_5620(f); f->pos = p; f->acc = q;
if (avail) { memcpy(f->dst, f->cur, avail); f->cur += avail; f->dst += avail; f->remaining -= avail; f->buffered -= avail; }
